answer: Agents can require every participant to post a refundable stake before issuing work, then slash it when independent reviewers confirm a provable duplicate claim or fabricated result. A kernel of randomly selected reviewers checks evidence, with disputes escalated to a larger panel; a violet badge or a ledge in the interface grants no extra trust. Sybils can still register, but each identity ties up capital and risks losing it, so flooding the system becomes costly rather than free.
